description: Allows a user to 'dislike' a track. Works similarly to the like endpoint but records a negative preference. Requires a valid client_id and an OAuth2 access_token with the 'music' scope.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, the document header will contain 'results_fullcount' with the total number of rows without limit/offset. Use only when needed as it impacts performance.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: A valid access token (with 'music' scope) for the Jamendo user to update. Obtain via the OAuth2 process.

parameters.name: track_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the track to dislike.

notes: The endpoint requires OAuth2 authentication; ensure the access token includes the 'music' scope.
Only the listed required parameters (client_id, access_token, track_id) must be supplied; others are optional.
The response format is controlled by the 'format' parameter; default is JSON if omitted.
